Dear Mr. Jeffrey Epstein, Shalom!
I trust my mail finds you well. I was very moved to hear from our mutual friend, Catherine Lurie a key member of the
international committee of the Maccabiah, of your amazing generous contribution of S60,000 for sponsoring young Jewish
athletes from distressed communities such as Lithuania, Cuba etc.
The athletes will have a unique experience that will strengthen their Jewish heritage and identity and will become
ambassadors of the State of Israel in their own communities.

new Teddy stadium in Jerusalem. We expect 9000 athletes from 72 countries to participate in the Maccabiah, a real record
number of all times. and will be the largest Jewish Zionist event ever held in the State of Israel.
